In the event of an emergency, passengers who have their seats in the emergency exit row may be asked to assist in a swift evacuation by following the cabin crew's instructions.

seat_service.eligibility_checklist_item_1: Able to communicate in Japanese or English
seat_service.eligibility_checklist_item_3: There are no accompanying passengers under 15 years old.
seat_service.eligibility_checklist_item_4: Does not require an escort or assistance when boarding
seat_service.eligibility_checklist_item_5: Able to provide emergency evacuation assistance, such as opening and closing aircraft doors.

seat_service.eligibility_checklist_item_7: You do not need to assist your companion in an emergency evacuation.
seat_service.eligibility_checklist_item_9: Agree to provide emergency evacuation assistance
seat_service.eligibility_checklist_item_10: Agree that luggage cannot be placed near to your feet or on your lap during takeoff and landing
seat_service.eligibility_checklist_item_11: Agree that this seat is not eligible for mobile check-in
seat_service.crew_instruction_items_item_1: Stop other passengers until the flight attendants have fully opened the emergency exit door. Stop passengers in the aisle by saying, "Wait here" and "leave your luggage."
seat_service.crew_instruction_items_item_2: After the evacuation slide is inflated, other passengers should be evacuated immediately.
seat_service.crew_instruction_items_item_3: Assist other passengers who are escaping behind you by using the escape slide or under the exit door.
seat_service.crew_instruction_items_item_4: Immediately tell people to leave the aircraft and evacuate far away.
seat_service.crew_instruction_items_item_5: Others (the crew will give specific instructions if necessary).
